    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = max(set(x for row in grid for x in row), key=lambda x: sum(v == x for row in grid for v in row))
    markers = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 4]
    # The isolated non-background, non-marker object is the stamp template.
    cells = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
             if grid[r][c] not in (bg, 4)]
    if not cells:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    r0, r1 = min(x[0] for x in cells), max(x[0] for x in cells)
    c0, c1 = min(x[1] for x in cells), max(x[1] for x in cells)
    anchor_r, anchor_c = (r0 + r1) // 2, (c0 + c1) // 2
    shape = [(r-anchor_r, c-anchor_c, v) for r, c, v in cells]
    out = [[bg for _ in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]
    # Keep the original example object and stamp its translated copies at each marker.
    for r, c, v in cells:
        out[r][c] = v
    for r, c in markers:
        for dr, dc, v in shape:
            rr, cc = r + dr, c + dc
            if 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w:
                out[rr][cc] = v
    return out
